Identity: cursor-grok-4.6-help. SLICE 2 progress on bd-01M16JJPDW36J3TWVBDJ5H6FFB (Credence first).

FORGE, then fix. Unpiped coreJVM/testOnly CredenceForgeSuite on the still-case-class type: Passed 2/2, exit 0. fromProduct((0.9, Some(p), None)) produced calibrated=Some(0.99) with calibrationModel=None; Credence.from of the same pair stayed Left. That is design-contract rule 3 as a one-liner.

Then Credence is a final non-case class (accessors, structural equals/hashCode, intentional toString). calibrated() no longer uses copy. Clean coreJVM/clean then testOnly ConstructionProbeSuite + IdsSuite: 15/15 after clean recompile. Positive control in the same file: SpanRef.fromProduct still typechecks (if that goes red the refusals are meaningless). fromProduct and copy refused from package storymodel4s.coreprobe.

Source is reserved and unstaged. Next: the other six slice-2 types, each checked for a representable invalid state before a probe. Landing order still slice 3 then 6 then 2.
